title: Minimum Threshold Path With Limited Heavy Edges
summary: In an undirected weighted graph, an edge is heavy when its weight exceeds a chosen integer threshold. Find the smallest threshold permitting a source-to-target path with at most k heavy edges, or -1 if no path can exist. The retrieved text does not state a lower bound on threshold; clarify that boundary when a path uses at most k edges before certifying the solver.
officialConstraints: 1..1000 vertices; 0..1000 edges; valid endpoint IDs; weights 1..10^9; 0<=k<=edge count.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
